scope: Cursor Agent-like sidebar New Agent, Delete draft, Archive, Delete, Restore, and search-result restore behavior
userFinding: Existing sidebar buttons and interactions must be fully implemented; Archive and Delete had visible controls but did not reliably mutate chat state.

observed: Cursor Agent keeps historical chats visible in the current repository after New Agent.
Completed chat rows expose Pin and Archive actions.
Draft chat rows expose Pin and Discard actions.
Opening a search or row target selects the concrete chat rather than only a generic agent.

sciforgeImplementation: SciForgeApp now passes workspace archivedSessions into the sidebar so hidden archived/deleted rows and retained history share the same project/search model.
Sidebar action guards were split into archivable and discardable checks: Archive remains activity-based, while Delete can remove the active draft.
Search result de-duplication now keys by scenarioId, sessionId, and threadState so archived/deleted results are not duplicated when both project groups and archivedSessions are present.
Search results continue to carry sanitized project-target refs and concrete session/thread state, then reuse openSidebarThread for active, retained, archived, and deleted sessions.

liveBrowserEvidence.tool: Playwright against local SciForge dev UI
liveBrowserEvidence.isolation: Fresh Microsoft Edge context with seeded localStorage and stubbed Workspace Writer responses for /api/sciforge/config and /api/sciforge/workspace/snapshot.
actions: Initial completed chat row showed one Archive button and one Delete button.
Clicked New Agent; the previous completed chat stayed visible and one New chat draft row appeared.
Clicked Delete on the New chat draft; the draft row disappeared and the previous chat remained visible.
Clicked Archive on the previous chat; it disappeared from the main list and appeared as one Archived chat search result.
Clicked the Archived chat search result; the previous chat restored to the main list.
Clicked Delete on the restored active chat; it disappeared from the main list and appeared as one Deleted chat search result.
Clicked the Deleted chat search result; the chat restored to the main list.
